Name: Language Switcher
Author: vilalotteria
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley locks its language at startup — to see how something is worded in another
language you'd normally have to quit, change the setting, and reload your save.

This mod switches the language instantly, with one key, while you keep playing. It's built
for people using the game to learn a language: flip to your target language to see how a
menu, item or conversation is phrased, then flip straight back to check you understood it.

It works between any two of the game's 12 languages, not just English and one other. If you
play in Chinese and are learning Italian, that's Chinese to Italian — English never has to
be involved.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][size=4]Known limitations[/size]
[/b]
These come from how the game handles text: it resolves text into a specific language at the
moment it's displayed and can't change it afterwards.

- If a menu is open (dialogue, TV, a letter, the map, your inventory) or a notification is on
  screen when you press the key, the switch waits until it closes. This is deliberate — it
  keeps text readable instead of leaving half-rendered characters on screen.
- Dialogue you've already seen stays in its original language. Use the replay log to read it
  in the other language.
- For dialogue with random or choice-based branches, the translation is best-effort. When the
  branch can't be identified with confidence, the log says so rather than showing a line that
  might be wrong.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI if you don't already have it.
2. Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder, so you end up with
  Mods/LanguageSwitcher/manifest.json
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. On the title screen, click the "Language Switch" button (bottom right) to pick your
  target language. No other mods needed.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Switch language with one key (default: K)
Menus, item names, tooltips and dialogue update immediately — no restart, no reloading your
save. Switches between whatever language you're currently playing in and your chosen target.

Dialogue replay log (default: L)
A scrollable window of recent NPC dialogue, with a key to flip each line between the original
and a translation. This exists because the game fixes text into a language the moment it's
drawn, so a conversation already on screen can't be re-translated — the log is how you go
back and read it afterwards. Player dialogue choices are captured too, so you can see the
options you didn't pick.

Set up from the title screen
Pick your target language and rebind both hotkeys from a button on the title screen. Keys
already used by the game (WASD, arrows, E, F, M, Y, Tab, number keys...) are rejected, so you
can't accidentally break your controls.

Generic Mod Config Menu supported (optional)
If you have GMCM, the same settings are available from its in-game Mod Options page.

Languages: English, Русский, 中文, Deutsch, Português, Français, Español, 日本語, 한국어,
Italiano, Türkçe, Magyar

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI 4.5.0 or later
Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
Generic Mod Config Menu — optional. The mod is fully configurable without it, from the title
screen button; GMCM just adds a second way to reach the same settings.
